SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN period='P2' THEN amount_units ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period='P1' THEN amount_units ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN period='P1' THEN amount_units ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS value FROM observations WHERE network_asset IN (SELECT network_asset FROM observations WHERE period='P1') AND network_asset IN (SELECT network_asset FROM observations WHERE period='P2')
